data.name: Jazak
data.gender_notes: Jazak is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jazak is an Arabic term used to express gratitude and appreciation. It is often used to thank someone for their good deeds. The name Jazak carries the meaning “Reward or recompense” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jazak usually hope their child will grow to embody reward or recompense and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Jazak is considered a way to express gratitude to Allah for His blessings.
data.etymology: Jazak belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Reward or recompense.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jazak total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
